title: Pagination is visible with a single page of results
body:
I'd like to be able to configure the pagination in some way so it does not appear at all, when there is only one page of results. At the moment there is a configuration option to hide it only when there are no results at all.

Is there a way to do this at the moment?

comments.body:
@bobylito Thanks! I was going to wrap the whole pagination widget into a new one, but you helped me realise I can override just the render method.

Looking forward to the pagination widget in the future when you would at least have an option for this, if not the ability to use templates for everything in the widget.

Regarding adding the option for a future version, what about:
- a `minPages` options (that mirrors the `maxPages`). If the number of pages is below that threshold, no widget is displayed
- or allowing `autoHideContainer` to accept a function instead of a boolean that let users decide when hiding the widget.

Just ideas on the top of my head, to be discussed.
@vvo But the render event does not provide the `params` object as an argument like the `render` method of the pagination widget does.
